quotes.text: The pioneers turned their wilderness into a fruitful field and made the desert blossom as a rose—precisely as prophesied by Isaiah centuries before (see Isaiah 32:15–16; 35:1).
quotes.speaker: The Exodus Repeated
quotes.attr: The Exodus Repeated, Russell M Nelson, CES Fireside, 7 September 1997

notes.text: The Invasion of Sennacherib (36:1-21) When faced with tremendous challenges, including the approach of the Assyrian armies, King Hezekiah turned to the Lord in prayer and sought counsel from the Lord's prophet; then he trusted the Lord to deliver him and his people.
